firstPlayerRule: Whoever can say “Spurtle Turtle” three times fast goes first.
officialTieBreak: If no one can say it, or more than one player can, the youngest player goes first.
internalEvidence: Fetched the PlayMonster-hosted rules PDF listed on playmonster.com/rules-and-activity-guide/ and extracted its text. PDF page 1: "Play • The player who can say, ‘Spurtle Turtle’ three times fast gets to go first! If no one can say it or if more than one player can say it, then the youngest player goes first."
